instagram.caption:
The kit for the baker you meant to become.
The Baking Zone in the Pantry. Holds everything you need to start a bake without a trip to the shop first.

What done looks like:
1. Flour, sugar and brown sugar in sealed containers you can open one-handed
2. Baking powder, bicarbonate of soda and yeast together in one small box with their dates showing
3. Cutters, cases and piping tips in a single lift-out bin, and no loose sprinkles rolling around the shelf

Free written steps for this zone, no signup: link in bio, or search 6S Success baking zone.
